cause.detail: Current view resolves reuse, but subject resolution looks up the outer source pin raw canonical entities. The virtual borrowed line exists only in that pin derived execution view.

findings.given: A current confirmed reference scene points to a pinned inner dependency. There is no fixed caption source pin to trigger incidental caption verification.
findings.when: Alter the dependency content without updating its stored contentHash and call productionCheckView.
findings.expected: Reject with integrity failure before returning a view; original canonical input remains unchanged.
findings.actual: productionCheckView returns a derived view without rejecting the corrupt reuse pin; the positive rejects assertion fails.

cause.detail: The helper resolves reuse synchronously without verifyReusePins; verifyProductionSources only verifies fixed caption subjects and not their recursive dependencies.

findings.scope: Direct component API finding. Normal UI captureRuntimeContent separately checks reuse hashes; this finding does not establish a normal App corruption bypass.

resolvedFindings.value: Old sourceA kept; current lineB independent. Native archive/new/clone retains old source. Direct unverified calls keep voice candidate unknown and add rule_context unknown, not true.

resolvedFindings.given: An independently copied line has historical lineage pointing to the old source; another rejected cue retains an old source position.
resolvedFindings.when: Merge or split the current original lines, including normal App save and cold reload.
resolvedFindings.expected: Keep historical source IDs/Unicode ranges while adding the new operation mapping; do not rewrite rejected evidence.
resolvedFindings.actual: Copy lineage.source and rejected cue anchor are rewritten to the new live line/block IDs. OriginalLineIds remains the older ID, making ancestry inconsistent.
resolvedFindings.historicalFailure: Copy lineage.source and rejected cue anchor are rewritten to the new live line/block IDs. OriginalLineIds remains the older ID, making ancestry inconsistent.

resolvedFindings.given: A confirmed storyboard depends on a cue via cueIds, and that cue uses the old material.
resolvedFindings.when: Replace the cue material through normal confirmation, atomically save, and cold reload.
resolvedFindings.expected: The dependent storyboard joins the same save as needs_review while old immutable snapshot stays intact.
resolvedFindings.actual: The cue and translation require review; its dependent storyboard remains confirmed.
resolvedFindings.historicalFailure: The cue and translation require review; its dependent storyboard remains confirmed.

resolvedFindings.given: A material confirmation preview starts at revision0 with one replacement ID.
resolvedFindings.when: Controlled direct-API input mutation changes project revision/name and replacement ID array while hashing yields.
resolvedFindings.expected: Capture the original revision/content/material inputs before the first await.
resolvedFindings.actual: Plan silently adopts revision9, later name, and the added replacement ID.
resolvedFindings.measurementLimit: Direct API await boundary; not a normal user mutation of React props.
resolvedFindings.historicalFailure: Plan silently adopts revision9, later name, and the added replacement ID.

resolvedFindings.given: Source approval or dialogue copy preview starts from original revision0/content.
resolvedFindings.when: Controlled direct-API mutation changes revision or source text during asynchronous hashing.
resolvedFindings.expected: Use the original base and immutable content, then require reconfirmation for later changes.
resolvedFindings.actual: Approval base becomes9; dialogue plan combines changed live original and copy derived from old text.
resolvedFindings.measurementLimit: Direct API await boundary; not physical device evidence.
resolvedFindings.historicalFailure: Approval base becomes9; dialogue plan combines changed live original and copy derived from old text.

resolvedFindings.expected: Fixed old-pin-only frame stays confirmed; actual live cue-dependent frame still needs_review.
